LESSON: WRITING 7.3.1 ASSESSMENT OF WRITING – NARRATIVE COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you ensure the quality of written work?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the features of a well- written composition for information

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 7.3.1 ASSESSMENT OF WRITING – NARRATIVE COMPOSITION
This lesson teaches Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise the features of a well- written composition for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition above.
2. Explain Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you ensure the quality of written work?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise the features of a well- written composition for information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
